name: 36618 · Mobile, AL
findings: ZIP 36618 (Mobile) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (55% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36618 (Mobile) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 36618 (Mobile) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 59% of all organizations here have no identified type.
